initial:
Create a production-ready RPG Maker MZ top-down dojo interior map bitmap. Reference image is ONLY a palette and pixel-art style reference: match its warm red-brown dojo wood, cream plaster and crisp Japanese game pixel clusters. Do not copy courtyard or characters.
Output exactly 816 by 720 pixels, a 17-column x 15-row map using invisible 48x48 PIXEL tiles. This means 48 pixels per tile, NOT 48 tiles across. Orthographic overhead RPG perspective with visible north wall faces, no vanishing point or isometric angles. Entire room visible, snug rectangular cutaway, no roof. No visible grid, text labels, UI, characters or outside scenery.
Precise composition: outer wall extent x=0..815, y=0..719. Back wall occupies y=0..143, one-tile-thick side walls x=0..47 and x=768..815. Wooden usable floor rectangle x=48..767 y=144..671, about 15x11 tiles. Bottom cutaway wall y=672..719 with centered open entrance x=336..479. Keep proportions and axis alignment faithful. Dark brown void only beyond wall if needed.
Humble neighborhood samurai dojo, cozy and modest but spacious for several practicing students. Large continuous OPEN wooden floor, horizontal warm muted red-brown planks with occasional subtle wear and scuffs, restrained texture, cared for daily. NO tatami training area. Cream plaster wall panels and exposed stout warm timber posts. Shoji windows in the north wall on both sides admit gentle even daylight, no beams or dramatic lighting.
Center a small recessed alcove in back wall, x=336..479 y=24..143, containing ONE plain narrow calligraphy scroll with simple black brush marks and a modest shallow offering shelf below, one small ceramic cup. No gold, ornate shrine, statues, banners or extra decorations. Small readable bokken rack against left wall, restricted to x=48..143,y=240..383. Low wooden equipment chest along right wall x=672..767,y=288..383, with two folded indigo cushions beside it x=672..767,y=384..479. These are the only furnishings.
Entrance centered in south wall, a recessed modest gray-brown shoe-removal area x=336..479,y=624..719 and one wooden step at y=600..623 leading onto training floor. No shoes blocking the path. Keep central x=192..623,y=192..575 completely empty. Paths clear, props small and readable at 48px gameplay scale.
Authentic 2D Japanese pixel game map with crisp pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, restrained warm muted palette, consistent overhead perspective and small contact shadows. No smoothing, painterly rendering, photorealism, perspective render, dramatic light, ornate decoration, characters, UI, visible grid, large tatami area.
revision: Edit this dojo map only to correct the vertical floor-to-wall proportions. Preserve all pixel-art style, palette, individual furnishings, center scroll alcove, side rack, chest, indigo cushions and centered genkan. Canvas target816x720, aspect17:15. Back wall must be only TOP20% of image, y0..144 of720. Bottom cutaway wall must be only BOTTOM6.7% of image y672..720. The wooden floor must extend from20% down to93.3% down, 144..672, so floor is15 by11 invisible48px tiles inside one-tile side walls. In the source back wall and bottom wall are far too tall, making floor too short. Compress wall heights substantially and extend open floor vertically. Keep props against edges: left rack x48..143 y240..383; chest x672..767 y288..383; cushions x672..767 y384..479; centered entrance x336..479 y624..719 and step y600..623.
